items.title: Official Website & 1st Pre-registration
items.description:
Led the full project from architecture design as the sole frontend engineer
Designed a BFF layer using Next.js Route Handlers to proxy external APIs and centralise request validation
Delivered on a 50% compressed timeline by adopting a rolling design-to-development handoff, enabling parallel workstreams across design, development, and QA
Built interactions for contents from scratch, tuning each animation to fit the game's visual identity

items.title:
Archer Remaster Teaser:
21st Anniversary Illustration Gallery
items.description:
Built a 3D gallery from scratch to showcase 21 years of brand illustrations
Consolidated 162 VBOs into a single draw call via shared geometry instancing, significantly reducing GPU memory overhead
Developed scroll-driven interaction logic for gallery rotation and year-counting animations with GSAP
Stabilising input responsiveness through debouncing

items.title: Code:BOX-The Shadow Approaching Millennum
items.description:
Built an immersive interactive web experience from scratch around the game's futuristic sci-fi aesthetic, tuning animation timing and transitions to stay true to its visual identity
Delivered multilingual support across Korean, English, and Thai for a large-scale global audience

items.title: New Character 'Neamhain' Update
items.description:
Designed and built an informational character page from scratch for the North American market
Crafted web animations to guide user attention and express the character's identity, with motion pacing shaped around the page's narrative structure

items.title: 1st Anniversary Festival
items.description:
Built an anniversary intro page featuring spring-themed particle graphics, with animation sequences designed to set the tone for the update
Implemented adaptive layouts and animations across mobile and PC to ensure a consistent experience on all screen sizes

info.name: Hello, I'm Chaewon!
info.about: Frontend developer crafting both sides of the screen — interactions users see, and environments developers feel. Having studied both design and engineering, I care about craft on screen and the systems behind it. I'm drawn to building not just polished interfaces, but better ways to build them: structure, automation, and the kind of tooling that makes a team's day-to-day a little less painful.
